name: AppShell
purpose: Provides the three-breakpoint application chrome: header, sidebar, and main area.
scenarios: Frame a dashboard with a fixed header and sidebar
Hide the sidebar on compact screens to prioritize content
Adapt the sidebar width on medium screens

header.description: Content for the top header region.

sidebar.description: Content for the side navigation region.

tabBar.description: Optional compact/tablet Navigation morph (TabBar). Hidden by the named app-shell container at desktop (80rem).

sidebarLabel.description: Accessible label for the sidebar region.

states.name: default
states.description: Shell is rendered with the current breakpoint layout.

antiPatterns: Do not put the only navigation in the sidebar without a compact alternative.
Do not make the sidebar overlap the main content without an explicit dismiss action.

keyboard: Tab moves through the header, sidebar, and main content in order
a11y.focus: Focus follows the document order; the sidebar is labelled.
a11y.labeling: Sidebar has an aria-label; main content is a main landmark.

responsive.strategy: Named container app-shell drives chrome: compact TabBar, tablet sidebar+TabBar, desktop sidebar without TabBar. Morph is @container 48rem/80rem == tablet/desktop.

breakpoints.compact: Header + main + TabBar when provided; sidebar is hidden.
breakpoints.large: Header + 16rem sidebar + main; TabBar slot is hidden.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. The sidebar border is on the inline-end; grid follows the document direction.
